dorm_rules.note: Provisional thresholds until A01 publishes the canon title table.

titles.name: Dropout Boy
titles.description: Failed an exam. Win the recovery duel to return to the academy.

titles.name: Apprentice Duelist
titles.description: A new student finding their feet at Duel Academy.

titles.name: Rookie Duelist
titles.description: A promising first-year with a few wins.

titles.name: Intermediate Duelist
titles.description: Consistent in free duels and timed challenges.

titles.name: Advanced Duelist
titles.description: A regular winner with exam experience.

titles.name: Expert Duelist
titles.description: Strong written scores and a growing collection.

titles.name: Veteran Duelist
titles.description: A seasoned duelist with a respectable card trunk.

titles.name: Elite Duelist
titles.description: Among the strongest students on the island.

titles.name: Champion Duelist
titles.description: A title reserved for tournament-level play.

titles.name: Duel Academy Champion
titles.description: Passed the monthly exams and dominates the academy.

titles.name: Duel King
titles.description: Cleared most of the story and built a world-class collection.

titles.name: King of Games
titles.description: The final title. Complete the school year and claim the crown.

titles.name: Occult Duelist
titles.description: Temporary title from the abandoned dorm events.

titles.name: Shadow Duelist
titles.description: Temporary title from a shadow game.

titles.name: Society Duelist
titles.description: Temporary title while aligned with the Society of Light.
